subject: Emotions
title: The Anterior Cingulate Cortex
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Anterior Cingulate Cortex.

hook.text: Deep in your brain, a region monitors conflicts between what you expect and what you get. It never rests.

buildup.text: The anterior cingulate cortex tracks errors and surprise. It fires when something doesn't match your plan.

discovery.text: People with ACC damage show flattened surprise. They can't detect when reality violates their expectations.

twist.text: The ACC also monitors pain, social rejection, and decision conflict. Surprise shares circuits with suffering.

climax.text: This overlap explains why shocking news feels physically painful—the same brain region processes both.

punchline.text: Surprise and pain share the same alarm system.

quiz.question: What does the anterior cingulate cortex monitor?
